verdict.rationale: logo-design-skill is a local Agent Skill: a SKILL.md folder plus dependency-free Python tools that runs inside a host agent. It has no service or data pipeline of its own, so whether user data trains AI models is decided by the host model provider, not by this product type. Nothing in the evidence shows the skill collects, transmits or governs data in a way that would make a training opt-out applicable.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
